media_convert.why.quality_small: The smallest files and the quickest conversion. Fine detail shows some loss
media_convert.why.sound_keep: The video keeps its sound, converted only where its file type cannot hold it
media_convert.why.clash_leave: A file that already has the new name is left alone, and the original stays
